mechanism_narrative: A declining trend in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.50% and is rising, it indicates a tightening monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 0.50% and rising, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in nonfarm payrolls signal deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings expectations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.5%, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to reduced consumer spending and corporate profit headwinds, over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE > 8.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in nonfarm payrolls over the past 3 months indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS has trended upward over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 500,000 units, it signals weak consumer demand and reduced economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where HOUST < 500.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in the core CPI index indicates an accommodative monetary policy amid rising inflation, which typically leads to positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of low industrial production (INDPRO < 90.0), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to reduced manufacturing output and economic slowdown, resulting in negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO < 90.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.
